children.title: Cycle 4 · Investigating Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory

detail.title: Investigating Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.summary: This update initiates a formal research project under the autocatalytic_memory topic to investigate experimental evidence distinguishing simple hysteresis from functional memory in chemical reaction networks. Previous theoretical frameworks have proposed that history-dependence can arise in non-equilibrium autocatalytic systems, but empirical validation remains limited. This research phase seeks to identify specific synthetic demonstrations where chemical networks maintain state across perturbations, moving beyond theoretical models to evaluate if these states constitute functional memory capable of supporting selection. The heredity_thresholds project remains parked pending these results.

detail.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.summary: This provisional notebook reviews the distinction between passive hysteresis and functional chemical memory in autocatalytic reaction networks. It synthesizes evidence suggesting that non-equilibrium feedback loops in reaction networks can enable compositional memory, distinct from simple thermodynamic relaxation (hysteresis) or template-directed inheritance.
detail.reason: Synthesizing available research to resolve the status of autocatalytic memory before advancing to new experimental searches.
